verdict.rationale: Mercury Books documents standard P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet reports, but nothing shows custom report building or filtering and grouping by class, location, or tag. The only class-related evidence is attaching Classes to transactions for QuickBooks and NetSuite integration customers. That is an adjacent sync feature for other ledgers, not dimensional reporting in Books.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
